name: Expanded Double Bento Box
pros: Expandable design saves space when empty
best_for: Office lunches with multiple compartments
expert_note: The gold standard for modern bento design. Collapses flat when not in use, saving bag space.

name: Flat Bento Box
pros: Ultra-slim profile fits in any bag
best_for: Slim bags and light lunches
expert_note: Perfect for those who carry a laptop bag and need a bento that fits alongside their computer.

name: Nunobiki Two-Tier Bento
best_for: Traditional bento presentation and gifts
expert_note: Hakoya lacquerware is made in Ishikawa Prefecture, the heart of Japanese lacquer craft. Hand-wash only.

name: Kokeshi Doll Bento Box
best_for: Kids lunches and bento beginners
expert_note: Shaped like a traditional wooden kokeshi doll. The lid doubles as a small plate.

name: Super Mario Bento Box
best_for: Kids who love video game characters
expert_note: Skater is the go-to brand for licensed character bento gear in Japan. Available in dozens of character themes.

name: YZFL Antibacterial Two-Tier Bento
best_for: Everyday adult bento with antibacterial protection
expert_note: The Ag+ antibacterial treatment is standard on higher-end Skater boxes. Reduces bacteria on food-contact surfaces.

name: JBQ-401 Stainless Steel Lunch Jar
best_for: Hot soups, stews, and porridge
expert_note: Thermos vacuum insulation is unmatched. Pre-heat with boiling water before filling for best heat retention.

name: JBG-2000 Fresh Lunch Box Set
pros: Includes insulated jar, two containers, and bag
best_for: Workers who need a full hot meal at lunch
expert_note: The complete Thermos lunch system. The insulated bag keeps everything at temperature. Popular with construction workers in Japan.

name: Mr. Bento Stainless Lunch Jar
pros: Four stackable containers in one jar
Vacuum insulation keeps food hot or cold
best_for: Full multi-course bento meals
expert_note: The iconic Mr. Bento is a complete meal system. Four containers for rice, soup, main dish, and sides. A cult favorite.

name: SW-FCE75 Food Jar
best_for: Soups, oatmeal, and cold meals
expert_note: Zojirushi SlickSteel interior resists corrosion and stains. The wide mouth makes it easy to eat directly from the jar.

name: LWU-A172 Stainless Lunch Jar
best_for: Large appetite workers and outdoor meals
expert_note: Tiger competes directly with Zojirushi in the insulated bento space. Their antibacterial finish is a unique advantage.

name: MCL-B038 Stainless Food Jar
best_for: Compact soup or porridge container
expert_note: One of the lightest food jars on the market. The rounded bottom means no food gets stuck in corners.

name: Animal Food Picks Set (16 pcs)
best_for: Making kids bentos fun and appealing
expert_note: Torune is the leader in decorative bento picks in Japan. These turn ordinary fruit and sides into playful characters.

name: Flower and Leaf Picks Set (20 pcs)
pros: Easy for small hands to grip
best_for: Elegant bento decoration
expert_note: The leaf picks double as dividers between foods. A simple way to elevate everyday bento presentation.

name: Stainless Steel Sword Picks (6 pcs)
best_for: Adults who want functional, stylish picks
expert_note: Modeled after katana swords. More durable than plastic picks and dishwasher safe for easy cleanup.

name: Vegetable Cutter Set (10 shapes)
pros: 10 different shapes including stars and hearts
Works on vegetables, cheese, and ham
best_for: Creating charaben (character bento) decorations
expert_note: Essential tool for anyone getting into charaben. Press firmly through carrots, cucumbers, or cheese slices.

name: Animal Bento Cutter and Stamp Set
pros: Cuts and stamps in one tool
Creates panda, bear, and bunny faces
best_for: Quick animal-shaped rice ball decoration
expert_note: Stamp onto nori sheets to create instant animal faces on onigiri. Takes seconds once you get the technique.

name: Silicone Baran Dividers (12 pcs)
best_for: Eco-friendly bento dividing
expert_note: Traditional baran are disposable grass-shaped dividers. These silicone versions last indefinitely and are dishwasher safe.

name: Silicone Side Dish Cups Set (8 pcs)
best_for: Separating wet and dry foods in bento
expert_note: These cups keep saucy sides from touching rice or bread. Essential for multi-item bento boxes.

name: Antibacterial Baran Sheets (50 pcs)
best_for: Quick food separation with hygiene benefits
expert_note: The antibacterial coating helps keep food fresh longer, especially in warm weather when bentos sit unrefrigerated.

name: Animal Sauce Containers Set (4 pcs)
pros: Holds soy sauce, dressing, or ketchup
best_for: Keeping sauces separate until ready to eat
expert_note: These tiny containers hold just the right amount of soy sauce or dressing. The squeeze design makes dispensing easy.

name: Mayo and Ketchup Pens (2 pcs)
pros: Write messages on food with sauce
best_for: Drawing faces and messages on bento food
expert_note: Used for charaben to draw faces on rice or eggs with ketchup. The fine tip gives surprising control.

name: Insulated Lunch Tote Bag
best_for: Keeping bento at safe temperature during commute
expert_note: Designed to fit Thermos lunch jars but works with most standard bento boxes. The insulation adds about 2 hours of temperature hold.

name: Drawstring Bento Bag (Azuma Bukuro)
best_for: Carrying bento in traditional Japanese style
expert_note: The azuma bukuro is a traditional Japanese bag shape. One piece of fabric folded and stitched into a simple, elegant carrier.

name: Compact Bento Cutlery Set
pros: Chopsticks, spoon, and fork in one case
best_for: All-in-one bento utensil solution
expert_note: The sliding case is designed to sit on top of a bento box, held in place by the bento band. Saves bag space.

name: Portable Chopsticks with Case
best_for: Adults who prefer quality wooden chopsticks
expert_note: Natural wood chopsticks have better grip on food than plastic. The lacquer finish protects against moisture damage.

name: Bamboo Chopsticks and Spoon Set
best_for: Eco-conscious bento users
expert_note: Bamboo is naturally antimicrobial. Hand wash and air dry to maintain the material over years of use.

name: Furoshiki Wrapping Cloth (50cm)
best_for: Wrapping bento boxes in Japanese style
expert_note: Furoshiki is an ancient Japanese wrapping art. The 50cm size is perfect for wrapping a standard two-tier bento box.

name: Wax Paper Wraps (50 sheets)
best_for: Wrapping onigiri and sandwiches inside bento
expert_note: Use to wrap individual onigiri or sandwiches. The wax coating keeps rice from sticking to the paper.

name: Aluminum Bento Box
best_for: Kids and retro bento aesthetics
expert_note: Aluminum bento boxes are a staple of Japanese elementary schools. They can be placed on warm surfaces to gently heat food.

name: Magewappa Cedar Bento Box
best_for: Japanese rice-based bentos and special occasions
expert_note: Magewappa boxes are handcrafted from Akita cedar. The wood absorbs moisture, keeping rice at the perfect texture for hours.

name: Onigiri Mold Set (3 shapes)
best_for: Making consistent onigiri for bento
expert_note: Wet the mold before pressing rice for best results. Makes perfectly shaped onigiri in seconds.

name: Nori Punch Set (3 designs)
pros: Punches face features from nori sheets
best_for: Creating kawaii face decorations on onigiri
expert_note: Press once through a nori sheet to get a complete set of eyes, nose, and mouth. Apply to rice balls with tweezers.

name: Egg Mold Bear and Bunny (2 pcs)
pros: Shapes warm boiled eggs into animals
best_for: Making shaped boiled eggs for charaben
expert_note: Place a freshly boiled and peeled egg in the mold while still warm. Refrigerate for 10 minutes for the shape to set.
